description: The 100-service fixture bench (flisk-sh/tdk-erp-system) booted on a clean GitHub-hosted runner (moved from the retired erp-scale-e2e workflow, #1301): flisk project and doctor, flisk up, then every backend answering /health through Traefik, and the report with the time to all backends healthy. Manual and weekly only: a full boot builds about 107 images. The workflow keeps its name and job until the e2e-scale cutover.
